Established in 1998 Lancer Scott offers renowned high-quality construction projects and facilities management services. - A customer-focused attitude and willingness to problem solve and help.

- Excellent organisational skill with the ability to multitask, prioritise and meet deadlines.

- A professional communication style, both written and verbal.
- A collaborative approach to contribute to team success.

To excel in this role, candidates should possess the following qualifications and experience:
- Proven experience in customer service, particularly face-to-face and over the phone.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office and other computer packages.
- Strong administrative skills with a sound understanding of delivering support services, preferably in remote locations.
- Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team environment.
- Excellent organisational skills with the ability to prioritise workload and respond effectively in emergency situations.

title: Accounts Assistant
description:
We are currently representing a fantastic client who is actively seeking a diligent and experienced Accounts Assistant to join their established finance department. Our client is looking for a capable professional who can hit the ground running, take ownership of the day-to-day transactional finance duties, and ensure the smooth running of the accounts function.

If you have a solid background in finance and are looking for a stable, fast-paced role within a supportive and growing business, this is an excellent opportunity to make a valued impact.

Key Responsibilities
- Ledger Management: Take full ownership of both the purchase and sales ledgers, ensuring all invoices are processed, coded, and authorized accurately and efficiently.
- Reconciliations: Perform regular and accurate bank, supplier, and credit card statement reconciliations.
- Credit Control: Proactively monitor debtor balances, chase outstanding payments via phone and email, and resolve any invoicing disputes.
- Payment Runs: Prepare weekly or bi-weekly supplier payment runs for management approval.
- Month-End Support: Assist the wider finance team with month-end preparations, including journal postings, accruals, and prepayments.
- Expenses: Process employee expense claims in line with company policy.

What Our Client is Looking For
- Proven, hands-on experience working as an Accounts Assistant or in a similar transactional finance role.
- AAT qualification (Level 3 or 4) is highly advantageous, though qualified by experience (QBE) candidates will be strongly considered.
- Strong IT proficiency, particularly in Microsoft Excel (e.g., VLOOKUPs, Pivot Tables) and previous experience using accounting software (e.g., Xero, Sage, QuickBooks).
- High level of numeracy and exceptional attention to detail.
- Excellent communication skills and the confidence to liaise effectively with both internal stakeholders and external suppliers/clients.

title: Venue Finder & Sales Co-ordinator
description:
Venue Finder & Sales Co-ordinator

In Any Event UK

Are you organised, confident on the phone and great with people? Do you enjoy researching brilliant venues, negotiating a great deal and turning an initial enquiry into a happy client?

In Any Event UK is looking for an enthusiastic Venue Finder & Sales Co-ordinator to join our friendly and busy events team.

This is a varied role combining venue finding, client relationship management, sales and event support. No two days are quite the same, so we're looking for someone who enjoys variety, takes ownership of their work and has the confidence to make things happen.

About In Any Event

In Any Event is an established, independent event management and venue finding agency. We work with a wide variety of clients to deliver everything from conferences and exhibitions to product launches, corporate events and special experiences.

Our clients are at the heart of everything we do. We're known for our personal approach, attention to detail and commitment to finding the right solution rather than simply the easiest one.

The Role

A key part of the position will be managing venue finding enquiries from initial brief through to confirmation.

You'll speak directly with clients to understand exactly what they're looking for, research suitable venues, check availability, negotiate rates and added value, and present the best options back to the client in a professional and engaging way.

You'll be responsible for keeping clients updated throughout the process and making sure every enquiry is managed accurately and efficiently.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Managing venue finding enquiries from start to finish
- Taking detailed client briefs and understanding their event requirements
- Researching and recommending suitable venues
- Contacting venues to check availability and place provisional holds
- Negotiating rates and added value on behalf of our clients
- Producing professional, client-facing venue proposals
- Keeping clients regularly updated throughout their search
- Maintaining accurate information within our bespoke enquiry and CRM systems
- Following up with clients after their events
- Managing venue-related administration, client recharges and credit arrangements
- Sales & Business Development

Sales is an important part of this position.

We're looking for someone who is comfortable picking up the phone, starting conversations and helping us develop new business.

You will:
- Make regular outbound sales calls to prospective clients
- Research potential new clients and opportunities
- Work towards a target of at least 20 sales calls per week
- Generate a target of 4 new business appointments per month
- Build and maintain relationships with existing and prospective clients
- Support promotions, special offers and client communications
- Attend exhibitions and networking opportunities when required

You don't need to be a pushy salesperson. We're looking for someone who is confident, personable, professional and genuinely enjoys talking to people and building relationships.

Event Support

You'll also become part of our wider events team, giving you the opportunity to get involved in the events themselves.

This may include:
- Supporting Event Managers with event administration and planning
- Assisting with delegate registration
- Working with our Eazybook registration system
- Producing reports and information for clients
- Helping with a variety of event tasks as required
- Attending and supporting events onsite, including occasional evenings and weekends

Who Are We Looking For?

We're looking for someone who is:

Enthusiastic and motivated

Naturally organised with excellent attention to detail

Confident speaking to clients and suppliers

Comfortable making outbound sales calls

Customer focused and committed to delivering excellent service

A strong communicator, both verbally and in writing

Able to manage multiple enquiries and deadlines

A good negotiator

Happy working independently while also being a real team player

Proactive and willing to take ownership

Positive, with a genuine "can do" attitude

Experience in venues, hospitality and the events industry

Previous experience within events, hotels, hospitality, venue finding, sales or customer service would be an advantage, but just as important to us is finding someone with the right attitude, personality and enthusiasm to learn.

Why Join In Any Event?

This is a great opportunity for someone who wants a role with genuine variety and the chance to develop within the events industry.

You'll work alongside an experienced events team, gain exposure to a wide range of clients, venues and events, and have the opportunity to see projects progress from the first enquiry right through to the event itself.

We're a close-knit team where everyone's contribution matters, and we're looking for someone who wants to become a real part of the business rather than simply fill a role.

Interested?

We'd love to hear from you.

title: Reception and Appointment Clerk
description: The Reception and Appointment Clerk works across a number of sites providing reception, administrative and appointment booking support for Haematology and Oncology services. The role involves booking appointments, managing telephone systems, supporting patient pathways and undertaking a range of administrative duties to ensure the smooth running of services across both Bristol and Weston. **Location - BHOC, Mrytle Road Admin office, South Bristol Community Hospital, North Bristol Community Hospital, Weston General Hospital** The Reception and Appointment Clerk works closely with a wide range of administrative teams including the Treatment Bookings Team, Clinic Coordinators, Medical Secretaries and Clinical Nurse Specialist Support Team. As the team deal with a wide range of enquiries, the postholder will be expected to liaise effectively with colleagues across multiple departments and locations. The Reception and Appointment Clerk provides a frontline welcome, support, information and signposting to patients receiving treatment for cancer and those living with non-malignant blood conditions. The role is an integral part of the multidisciplinary team supporting both outpatient and day unit services Communication: o To welcome patients to the department, ensuring that patient information held is correct (address, telephone numbers, GP details, Next of Kin details), and that the attendance is recorded on Medway/Mosaiq. o To liaise with patients, wards, clinical staff, GPs and Trust support staff in person, via telephone and email as and when necessary. Patient Care: o To show a caring and professional approach towards patients, relatives and carers. This may require acting with resilience to deal with sometimes distressed patients and relatives in an empathetic manner Organising and Planning: o To carry out associated duties, for example, call handling, outcoming clinic appointments, booking bloods, managing the team inbox, scanning, and patient filing. Service Development and Research: o Attend training courses as required to support personal development and the needs of the service. o Assist in training of new members of the team. o To take part in departmental audits and associated duties. title: Receptionist Call Handler
description: An opportunity has arisen within our reception team for a team player with a can do attitude who thrives working in a busy, demanding and ever-changing customer service environment. The majority of the work will be telephone based which requires a skill set to efficiently deal with high call volumes whilst maintaining a pleasant and caring manner. In addition you will provide general assistance to the practice team and project a positive and friendly image to patients and other visitors arriving at the practice. The work pattern is part time Monday to Friday and some Saturdays. Flexibility to cover additional shifts due to annual leave, training and sickness is an essential requirement of this role. Previous call centre experience is desirable. For a full job description please e-mail your request. Blow is an outline of the Key Areas of Responsibility: Ensure a professional and efficient reception service is provided to patients and other visitors Deal with general enquiries and explain practice procedures where required Make new and follow-up appointments Communicate test results in an accurate manner Explain practice arrangements and formal requirements to new patients and those seeking temporary cover and ensure procedures are completed Enter patient information on to the practice clinical system as required Process prescriptions and deal with enquiries Receive payment for non-NHS services provided Open and distribute practice mail Keep waiting area tidy and ensure information is up to date General administrative duties Undertake a share of communal duties and any other additional duties appropriate to the post as requested by the Office Manager, Practice Manager or Partners Key Responsibilities Patient Access and Customer Service Act as the first point of contact for patients, relatives, carers, and healthcare professionals. Handle telephone, face-to-face and electronic enquiries professionally and efficiently. Book, amend and cancel appointments in accordance with practice procedures. Support patients to access the most appropriate service through effective signposting. Manage walk-in enquiries and maintain an organised waiting environment. Patient Administration Complete new patient and temporary resident registrations. Maintain accurate patient records and demographic information. Process requests for medical summaries, letters, results, sick notes and vaccination-related services. Manage eConsultations and other digital requests in accordance with practice processes. Complete administrative workflows allocated by clinicians and colleagues. Prescriptions and Clinical Support Process prescription requests accurately and efficiently. Respond to prescription enquiries and liaise with pharmacies and clinicians. Support clinicians with administrative tasks linked to patient care. Act as a chaperone when trained and required. Communication and Correspondence Manage generic email accounts and incoming practice correspondence. Process ambulance reports, letters and electronic communications. Print and distribute documentation as required. Ensure all reception tasks are actioned within agreed timescales. Operational Responsibilities Open and close reception and practice areas in accordance with procedures. Process payments received in person and by telephone. Manage incoming deliveries, post and internal correspondence. Maintain stock levels of forms, leaflets and administrative supplies. Monitor designated storage and sample areas where applicable. Maintain a clean, professional and welcoming environment. Clinics and Service Support Support seasonal vaccination programmes including Flu and COVID clinics. Provide support for Saturday and extended access clinics where required. Assist with patient recalls, invitations and clinic administration. Team Working Work collaboratively with colleagues to ensure continuity of service. Respond flexibly to changing workloads and operational pressures. Contribute positively to team objectives and service improvements. Core Competencies Excellent communication, customer service, attention to detail, organisation, digital literacy, professionalism, confidentiality and problem-solving skills. Values and Behaviours Patient focused, respectful, inclusive, accountable, reliable, professional and committed to continuous improvement. Confidentiality and Information Governance Maintain confidentiality at all times and comply with data protection legislation, information governance standards and practice policies. Health, Safety and Safeguarding Support a safe environment for patients, visitors and colleagues and comply with safeguarding, infection prevention and health and safety procedures. Training and Development Participate in mandatory training, appraisal and ongoing professional development activities. Flexibility Clause This job description is not exhaustive and may be amended to reflect changing service needs. The post holder may be required to undertake other duties consistent with the role.
